releases.notes:
ClipStack 1.1.0

• ClipStack now updates itself. It checks once a day and installs new versions with one click (Settings → General → Software Update, or Check for Updates… in the menu). Every download is verified against a signature built into the app before anything is replaced.
• Spotlight-style panel: opens centred on the screen you are working on, with a larger search field and a detail pane that shows the full text, the whole image, every file, or the colour before you paste. Turn the pane off in Settings → Appearance.
• The panel always stays on screen — it no longer slides off the bottom when you open it from a field at the foot of the display.
• Starts at login from the first launch, and keeps recording until you quit it. Change this in Settings → General.
• Change Shortcut… is now one click away in the menu-bar menu.
• New Settings window in the style of System Settings.
• Fixed: the list no longer scrolls on its own when the pointer rests over it, and the bottom rows can be reached with the mouse.
• Removed the ⌘1–⌘9 shortcuts; they collided with browser tab switching.
• On first launch from the disk image or Downloads, ClipStack offers to move itself to Applications.
